title: S Bahn Berlin Pack
description: This project adds the famouse BR481 and 483 of the berlin S Bahn
body:
This Mod adds the Famouse BR 481,BR483 and BR485 form the berlin Sbahn. In this pack you get 2 paintshops of the BR481 and BR485. With detailed Exterior and interior and of course the berlin charme you can expand your trainnetwork. This Projekt is a beta and may maintain bugs or texture errors. If you find something write it in my Discord
